reason: FOUND BY REAL-WORLD TESTING while exercising the waive path. --id and --fingerprint are optional at the argparse layer because the desired-state POLICY branch uses neither, so an empty --id fell through to the entries branch and recorded {"": {...}} in docs/setup-audit/ledger.json — a tracked file. That entry can never match a finding, reads as noise in review, and is silently overwritten by the next unnamed one. Now refused with a message naming both missing flags and where to get them; exit 1 verified, ledger untouched. Discrimination checked: a real waive (id 005e5aeabf76 / fp 641e7369, taken from an actual finding) still records and was reverted after. Required the FINGERPRINT alongside the id deliberately — the fingerprint ties a waiver to the finding CONTENT, where an id alone waives whatever later carries that id.
title: ledger-add wrote a waiver keyed by empty string into the tracked ledger
